This is version 4, a complete rewrite.

Version 3 was a console program you configured with command-line flags, retyped on every launch. Version 4 is a desktop application: a window with settings screens, a tray icon it sits in while you play, and a config that remembers what you picked so you never think about flags again.

The presence text is yours now too. Every phase, from in client through in game, has a template you can edit with a live preview beside it. Updates install from inside the app, so this is the last time you download an exe by hand.

Everything version 3 put on your Discord profile is still here: summoner icons, rank emblems, KDA and creep score, champion skins including the animated ultimates, TFT companions, Arena and spectating.

### Coming from version 3

- Delete your old `leagueRPC.exe`. Leaving it running alongside this means two programs fighting over the same Discord presence.
- Windows only. Vanguard ended Linux support, and there is no macOS build.
